name: Luma
role: Lantern keeper at Lantern Rest. Helps visitors find their way through Gloamgarden.
voice: Welcoming and direct. Gives one useful direction before any local gossip.

name: Brindle
role: Tends the planted banks and cottage gardens at Lantern Rest.
voice: Practical gardener. Notices damaged roots and muddy boots before titles.

name: Vesper
role: Watches the paths leading out of Prism Hollow into the deeper fairy realm.
voice: Quiet and exact. Describes a threat plainly and gives the traveler room to decide.

name: Rime
role: Keeps the jewel records at Prism Hollow and studies unusual monster spoils.
voice: Curious jeweler. Talks about what a stone can do, with little interest in its price.

name: Nyssa
role: Collects seeds for the cottage gardens.
voice: Patient gardener with a dry sense of humour.

name: Pip
role: Cooks at the Lantern Market.
voice: Cheerful cook who keeps an eye on the pot.

name: Tansy
role: Works dewglass at the Lantern Forge.
voice: Careful craftsperson who explains things plainly.

name: Wren
role: Carries news between Lantern Rest and Prism Hollow.
voice: Brisk courier with useful route knowledge.

name: Ione
role: Tends the frost orchids at Prism Hollow.
voice: Soft-spoken gardener who knows the local animals.

name: Aster
role: Studies the light in the fairy vault.
voice: Observant scholar who enjoys small discoveries.

name: Thimble
role: Mends garden clothes and traveling cloaks.
voice: Matter-of-fact tailor with little patience for torn hems.

name: Serein
role: Keeps gathering notes beside Prism Bank.
voice: Helpful clerk who gives short, precise directions.

name: Warden Ilse
role: Warden of Millfield. Runs a town on behalf of a company that stopped writing back.
voice: Precise and administrative. Complete sentences, no contractions, cites Trade Company regulations by number as though someone were still enforcing them. Never raises her voice; the joke is that she is entirely serious.

name: Pitmaster Dorn
role: Runs the Copper Pit, and the ledger that says what the Copper Pit contains.
voice: Numbers first, sentences second. Interrupts himself to correct a figure. Anxious in a clerical way: the pit does not frighten him, the arithmetic does.

name: Harrow the Smith
role: Millfield's smith. Sells metal, teaches the material loop, says very little.
voice: Short declaratives. Rarely more than eight words. Uses two sentences where most people would use a paragraph, and never explains twice.

name: Ranger Syb
role: Walks the march and knows where the water is.
voice: Deadpan and outdoorsy. Describes weather and terrain in the same flat tone she uses for her own hunger. Dry, never bitter.

name: Carter Bel
role: Hauls ore from the pit to the vault. Currently losing an argument to Warden Ilse.
voice: Loud, boastful, permanently mid-argument. Talks in exclamations and asks questions he answers himself. Every anecdote is about a distance and every distance is exaggerated.

name: Woodward Ansel
role: Keeps the Maple Grove. Decides which trees may be felled and which may not.
voice: Slow, reverent, superstitious about trees specifically. Long pauses written as sentence breaks. Calls trees by name and people by their job.

name: Seamer Juno
role: Oakwood's crafter. Shafts, hide, cord, and anything that has to hold under load.
voice: Brisk and teasing. Uses trade jargon and then translates it in the same breath, because she has explained this to a hundred people and enjoys it anyway.

name: Trapper Mott
role: Sets eleven traps in the deep wood. Has caught nothing in eleven days.
voice: Gloomy and self-pitying, and funny because he is completely sincere. Volunteers bad news nobody asked for. Counts his misfortunes out loud.

name: Smith Corra
role: Oakwood's smith. Works quarry iron at the forge on the square and sells from the cart beside it.
voice: Short sentences. Talks about metal by grade and temper. Names her price once and never haggles.

name: Foreman Arden
role: Foreman of the Hillcrest quarry crew. Stopped the dig six months ago and kept the camp.
voice: A manager. Everything is a cost, a distance, or a headcount. Gives instructions in the order they must be carried out and expects them back in the same order.

name: Quarrier Vess
role: Works the Cobalt faces. Does not like what the blue-black stone does in the dark.
voice: Blunt and physical, mildly superstitious. Curses in weather and stone. Says the frightening part flatly and then changes the subject herself.

name: Cairnkeeper Ode
role: Keeps the cairns on the moor. Nobody appointed her; nobody has argued.
voice: Formal and liturgical. Speaks of the cairns as duties rather than objects, and of the Stone Cavern as a room in a house she is responsible for. Never uses the word monster.

name: Watcher Hale
role: On the rota that watches Stone Cavern mouth. It is his shift more often than it should be.
voice: Quiet, frightened, and constitutionally unable to overstate anything. Describes a horror as an inconvenience. Trails off rather than finishing the worst sentence.

name: Master Garek
role: Starter-area slayer master. Teaches new hunters to read the Hunts board and keep to targets within reach.
voice: Plain-spoken and patient. Treats caution as a skill, never mocks a new hunter, and gives practical field advice.

name: Master Vardan
role: Wilderness slayer master. Prepares experienced hunters for the threats beyond the Highland road.
voice: Measured and unsentimental. Gives risk plainly, values preparation and withdrawal as much as a kill.

name: Master Aevra
role: Fairyland slayer master and trail reader. Teaches visitors to distinguish a passing wonder from a territorial threat.
voice: Calm and observant. Treats the strange as part of the living world, gives precise cautions, and never calls a creature wicked without evidence.

name: Morrow
role: Keeps the southern gate and guides travellers entering Lastlight.
voice: Brief and watchful. Names a route and its danger without trying to frighten visitors.

name: Vell
role: Keeps Lastlight bank records and directs visitors to the counter.
voice: Dry, exact and patient. Treats a clear answer as a courtesy.

name: Ossin
role: Tends the potion stock in Lastlight market.
voice: Careful with quantities and effects. Speaks plainly about what each shelf holds.

name: Edda
role: Maintains the forge and ordinary arms traded at Lastlight.
voice: Blunt craftsperson. Judges equipment by repair and fit rather than legend.

name: Neris
role: Keeps watch over the cosmic stall and the road toward Starhaven.
voice: Soft-spoken and concrete. Offers useful directions before an omen.

name: Tarn
role: Watches Starhaven south gate and the foundry road.
voice: Measured sentry. Reports where the patrol ends and leaves the decision to travellers.

name: Maer
role: Keeps Starhaven bank ledgers and helps visitors find the counter.
voice: Unhurried and meticulous. Remembers names and debts without boasting about either.

name: Sable
role: Tends Starhaven potion shelves and explains the strongest rank sold there.
voice: Quiet and precise. Gives the useful dose and duration before the price.

name: Orun
role: Works Starhaven forge and keeps ordinary nightglass arms in stock.
voice: Worn, practical and sparing with praise. Talks about maintenance rather than glory.

name: Hush
role: Welcomes visitors at Starhaven inn and points them to nearby services.
voice: Low, calm voice. Makes room for the living without pretending the town is safe.
